Usage: blackdot vault <command> [options]

Session:
  unlock            Unlock vault and cache session

  status            Full vault status with drift detection
  quick             Quick status check (login/unlock only)

Sync:

Items:
  list              List vault items

Config:

  backend           Show or set vault backend
  init              Initialize vault setup

  blackdot vault unlock

  # Check status
  blackdot vault status

  # Pull secrets from vault
  blackdot vault restore

  # Push local changes
  blackdot vault push --all

Typical Workflow:
  First time:   blackdot vault init      → Choose backend & discover secrets
  Unlock:       blackdot vault unlock    → Unlock vault for operations
  Add secrets:  blackdot vault push      → Push local changes to vault
  New machine:  blackdot vault restore   → Pull secrets from vault
  Re-scan:      blackdot vault scan      → Find new SSH keys/configs
